name: Lumax Auto Technologies Limited

timeline.x: [General Updates] Lumax Auto Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange that the Company has completed the sale of its entire equity stake aggregating to 50% of the equity share capital of Lumax Jopp Allied Technologies Private Limited, to Jopp Holding GmbH, Germany, the Joint Venture Partner on June 29, 2026.
[Acquisition] Lumax Auto Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange about completion of the acquisition of remaining Equity Stake of 15.97% in Lumax FAE Technologies Private Limited

[Acquisition] Lumax Auto Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors in its meeting held on May 29, 2026 have considered and approved the proposal to invest upto Rs. 3 (Three) Crores in Lumax Yokowo Technologies Private Limited, in the form of subscription of additional Equity Share Capital.

[Acquisition] Lumax Auto Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors, at its meeting held on May 29, 2026 have considered and approved the proposal to acquire the remaining stake of 15.97% in Lumax FAE Technologies Private Limited (LFAE)from its existing shareholder i.e., Francisco Albero S.A.U (FAE) and execution of the SharePurchase Agreement and other documents. Post this acquisition LFAE will become a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company.
